questions.text: On a past adjustment, Sahil should have received Rs. 68,000 and Tina Rs. 30,000, but the profit of Rs. 98,000 was wrongly shared equally. In the single adjusting entry, Sahil's capital account is credited by:
questions.explanation: Sahil: Cr 19000 Tina: Dr 19000 Sahil net = Rs. 19,000 (credited)  Correct option B. Distractors: A = halved the adjustment; C = doubled the adjustment; D = subtracted the correct share from the whole profit.
